modules.name: UZZ
modules.description: Ultimate Ztep Zequencer. 16-step sequencer with per-step Pitch/Octave/Duration/Mod1/Mod2 and bipolar Prob/Pulse, eight step modes (Play/Mute/Skip/Accum±/Pulse/Gated/Hold), per-row randomize and shift, multiple direction modes (Forward/Backward/Pendulum/Ping-Pong/Random/Drunk/Odd-Even/Jump/Converge/Diverge), accumulator with modulo wrap, swing, slew, polyphonic step-gates output and EOC.

modules.name: UZZ-X
modules.description: CV expander for UZZ: modulate steps, start, direction, clock ratio, swing, probability and accumulator; step-address CV, row-shift and accumulator-reset triggers, reverse gate

modules.name: ONE
modules.description: 6HP MIDI-to-CV for Oxi One. V/Oct, Gate, Velocity, 8x CC, Clock, CLK/n (divisions), Run. Supports Mono, Poly, Chord, Multitrack and Matriceal modes.

modules.name: MULTI
modules.description: 10HP Expander for OXI-CV. Adds 8 configurable tracks with V/Oct, Gate, and Velocity outputs.

modules.name: APC40 CTRL
modules.description: MIDI-to-CV bridge for Akai APC40 Track Control, Device Control, Cue and Crossfader CCs on MIDI channel 1, plus the 8 channel faders (CC7 on channels 1-8).

modules.name: CAP
modules.description: 6HP ducking VCA with sidechain envelope and manual trigger. Stereo audio in and out (right normalled to left), envelope CV and end-of-cycle outputs, and a level slider that doubles as the gain meter. Recovery, depth and jitter controls, humanised per hit with a correlated random walk so no two ducks are identical. Patch EOC back into TRIG and it free-runs as a jittered LFO or function generator. Polyphonic.

modules.name: UNIT-D
modules.description: Compact deterministic polyphonic generative sequencer based on unit-distance graph walks. Seeded 2D nodes create graph transitions, with musical density, gate-density and bipolar 16/32-step gradual lock controls, quantized minor-scale pitch, gate, accent, X CV and Y CV outputs.

modules.name: ATEK303
modules.description: Emulation of the Roland TB-303 voice: VCO, diode-ladder filter, decay envelope and accent. Cut Off, Resonance, Env Mod, Decay, Accent and Tuning, all six with a CV input and attenuverter. V/Oct, Gate, Accent and Slide inputs.

modules.name: ATEK303 SEQ
modules.description: Turing-machine style algorithmic generator for 16-step acid lines. GENERATE makes a new seed, or with BLOCK mutates time, notes/octaves and slides/accents as a single gesture. V/Oct, gate, accent, slide and end-of-cycle outputs, plus an expander for ATEK303.
